 Aditya Kumar Halwasiya has acquired 5.10 crore equity shares of PC Jeweller Ltd at Rs 14.43 per share in a transaction valued at approximately Rs 73.59 crore, according to the company’s press release. The acquisition took place on October 15, 2026.
Halwasiya’s investment portfolio includes companies across financial services, organised retail, banking and defence technology. His investments include Tourism Finance Corporation of India, Baazar Style Retail, Karnataka Bank, South Indian Bank and Apollo Micro Systems.
 Halwasiya is the chairman and managing director of Cupid Ltd, a listed company operating in the healthcare and consumer products segments.
 Advt 
 PC Jeweller, established in 2005, manufactures, retails and exports jewellery, including gold, diamond, silver and wedding jewellery. The company is listed on the BSE and the National Stock Exchange.
The jewellery retailer said it cleared all outstanding dues to its 14 consortium banks on September 25, 2026, and officially became debt-free .
